## Evidence

Background tier-2 full suite exit 1 in ~375s. 10 failed / 820 passed. Check-run `rec-a24a9ec0-30f8-41e7-a2dc-c8552984c3ae` (revision recorded dirty due to untracked `.tier2/` logs — gitignore missing).

Created under budget (3): fix-test_dashboard_app, fix-test_dashboard_journal, fix-test_discuss_skill.

Not created (budget exhausted): tests/test_evidence_loop.py, tests/test_plan_landing.py, tests/test_plan_wave_rules.py, tests/test_verify_authority.py.

## Consequence

Phase gate blocked: no passing tier-2 at head. Landing merge deferred. Remaining failures need human triage or a raised fix budget / follow-on wave.

## Follow-up

Approve executing the three fix tasks, then decide how to cover the four remaining modules (another wave, raise budget, or waive with finding).
